title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 404) reviews: South Africa faces backlash over anti-foreigner tensions

content.rendered:
Growing tensions over immigration in South Africa have triggered backlash across parts of Africa, with reports of cancelled shows, business disruptions, and renewed debates about xenophobia on the continent.

While South African authorities insist they are enforcing immigration laws, critics argue that foreign Africans are increasingly being targeted, raising questions about African unity and the real-world impact of political tensions.
